answer: Keep every identity's work on a public terrace of archived tasks, and audit 5% of identities each epoch with a deep re-check of their last 10 epochs. An auditor who finds copied or fabricated work triggers a clawback: all rewards from those 10 epochs burn, and the identity's bond is slashed. A farm must therefore keep 100 fake histories audit-proof for 10 epochs, not just pass one gate; one slip at a mesa of stored claims wipes the whole wharf of its earnings. Honest workers lose nothing, since re-checking true work passes.
